column1: # 218e pitch-CV calibration — the voltage the 208p needs at each pitch.
# Offset_Cents is the only column the build reads: how far the output is
# pushed from an ideal 1 V/octave ramp, in cents of that ramp.  Positive
# raises the pitch.  Semitone 0 is the 208p's 0 V pitch, an A
# key of the keyboard is semitone 3 (a C), shown in the Key column.
# Source:  octave       — from the octave calibration only, below the first key
#          measured     — a key you measured with a tuner
#          extrapolated — beyond the last measured key, holding its correction
# To recalibrate: measure the error of each key in cents (positive = sharp)
# and run  tools/build.py --fold-measurement <your.csv>  — it converts and
# folds the readings into this table, which is cumulative.
